lines.t: I’ve been running in circles, chasing shadows in my chest
Building idols out of memories, never finding any rest
Every mirror shows a stranger with these scars I try to hide
But You’ve been whispering in the wreckage, “Lay your weapons down tonight”
I feel the thunder in my veins, as all my kingdoms start to fall
If I lose everything I’ve made, will I still hear You when You call?
Tear down every wall I’ve raised, burn my pride to ash and dust
Let the fire of Your mercy be the only thing I trust
I’m not enough, I never was, but You still cover all my shame
So I’ll fall apart in Your arms, be remade in holy flame
I have tasted empty victories on the altars of my fear
Tried to bury all my questions, but they’re screaming in my ears
Yet in the ruins of my failure, there’s a heartbeat in the dark
A gentle pounding at the doorway, like a hammer on my heart
I feel the thunder in my veins, as all my kingdoms start to fall
If I lose everything I’ve made, will I still hear You when You call?
Tear down every wall I’ve raised, burn my pride to ash and dust
Let the fire of Your mercy be the only thing I trust
I’m not enough, I never was, but You still cover all my shame
So I’ll fall apart in Your arms, be remade in holy flame
When I reach the end of me, when my final strength is gone
You are still the song inside me, You’re the dusk and You’re the dawn
Every chain I clung to tightly, every secret that I kept
Falls away beneath Your footsteps, as You wade into my depths
Break me open, pour me out, let this heart beat only Yours
Let the roar of heaven’s thunder shake these old and rusted doors
If I lose the life I wanted, let me find the life You give
I would rather die to myself just to finally, truly live
Tear down every wall I’ve raised, burn my pride to ash and dust
Let the fire of Your mercy be the only thing I trust
I’m not enough, I never was, but You still cover all my shame
So I’ll fall apart in Your arms, be remade in holy flame
In the silence after screaming, when the last light fades to gray
I will rest inside Your presence, and rise up brand new someday

Building idols out of memories, never finding any rest
